artworks.title: The End
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people and part of a third individual. One person is lying down with their head on a pillow, wearing comfortable clothing. Another person, wearing a headscarf, leans over them in a caring gesture. A third person's head is partially visible at the foot of the bed. The background is a dimly lit room with a bright wall lamp illuminating the scene.

artworks.title: The Tribute Money
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing closely together. Two individuals are interacting at the center; one reaches out towards the other. On the right, a person with a halo above their head is holding something. They have a beard, long, wavy hair, and wear a long robe-like garment. On the left, a figure is holding money bags and wearing layered clothing. Other figures surrounding them have various head coverings and are close together. The background includes an intricately patterned wall and an arched structure at the top left, indicating an interior location.

artworks.title: Pentecost [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a gathering of figures in an architectural setting with columns and arches. At the top is a radiant circular light emitting rays, with a dove-like figure in the center. The figures below have expressive hand gestures and varied facial expressions. A central seated figure has a serene expression and a halo around the head. The drawing is in monochrome tones with white highlights for contrast.

artworks.title: Noli Me Tangere [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a detailed and atmospheric scene. One person stands slightly to the right, facing the viewer. He wears a high-crowned hat with a feather and intricate patterns, along with a tunic. The second figure, likely female, is kneeling or leaning towards the standing person. She wears a cloak and veil, with a halo around her head. The background features cloudy skies and a walled structure. The scene is depicted in monochrome with detailed shading and lines.

artworks.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray ink and graywash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure surrounded by lions. The scene shows a bearded figure reclining amidst seven lions in an architectural setting with arches and columns. The lions and the figure are detailed with shading and lines to add texture. Above the figure, there are two additional figures on a higher architectural level. The use of light and shadow, along with architectural details, gives the composition depth and complexity.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray ink and graywash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures beside a well with distant figures and buildings in the background. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic style using shades of gray with highlights and shadows. The figures are elaborately dressed, one leaning on the well and the other sitting on its edge holding a large jug. Architectural elements such as columns frame the well, and variations in the drawing strokes add texture. In the background, there are lightly sketched figures engaged in an activity, with buildings and a mountainous landscape extending into the distance. The drawing captures a sense of interaction and setting, with attention to fabric flow and natural scenery.

artworks.title: Capean otro encerrado  (They Play Another with the Cape in an Enclosure)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bull and three individuals in motion. The scene depicts a bull on the left side, interacting with one of the individuals who is holding an object or cloth. The figures are dressed in garments reminiscent of Middle Eastern or North African attire, such as turbans and flowing robes. The background is abstractly defined, with shading suggesting a flat, open space or arena. The energy is dynamic, with contrasts in dark and light etching creating a sense of movement and tension.

artworks.title: Los Moros hacen otro capeo en plaza con su albornoz (The Moors Make a Different Play in the Ring Calling the Bull with Their Burnous)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a bull, two individuals, and a plain background. The individuals are interacting with the bull. The figures are wearing elaborate clothing. The drawing includes detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Un caballero espanol mata un toro despues de haber perdido el caballo (A Spanish Knight Kills the Bull after Having Lost His Horse)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a matador confronting a fallen bull beside a horse. The scene depicts a matador grappling with a bull that is collapsed on the ground. The bull's body is sprawled out with its legs bent under it, and the bull's horns are prominently shown. A horse is depicted reclining on its side to the right. The background is a textured, muted space, emphasizing the figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Carlos V. lanceando un toro en la plaza de Valladolid (Charles V Spearing a Bull in the Ring at Valladolid)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: The image shows a man riding a horse. He is seated on the horse, holding the reins with both hands as the horse moves dynamically. The man appears to have a mustache and is wearing a hat with a feather. His attire includes a fitted jacket, a sash across his chest, and knee-high boots. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects. The background consists of a simple, shaded gradient.

artworks.title: El Cid Campeador lanceando otro toro  (The Cid Campeador Spearing Another Bull)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a bull and a horse with a rider engaged in a dynamic scene of bullfighting. The bull appears to be charging towards the rider on horseback. The rider is wearing traditional bullfighting attire, including a feathered hat. The horse is depicted in motion, seemingly preparing to evade. The use of line shading and tonal contrasts adds depth and texture to the image, capturing the tension and energy of the encounter.

artworks.title: Desjarrete de la canalla con lanzas, medias-lunas, banderillas y otras armas (The Rabble Hamstring the Bull with Lances, Sickles, Banderillas and Other Arms)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bull in a bullfighting scene. The central focus of the image is a bull, standing tall in the foreground, surrounded by a dramatic bullfighting scene. In the image, multiple figures are depicted holding various implements, seemingly engaged in a standoff or skirmish with the bull. The figures are arranged in dynamic poses, adding a sense of movement and tension to the scene. The background is minimalistic, directing the viewer's attention to the interaction between the bull and the individuals. The use of contrasting shades and strong lines gives depth and structure to the image.

artworks.title: Un caballero espanol en plaza quebrando rejoncillos sin auxilio de los chulos (A Spanish Mounted Knight in the Ring Breaking Short Spears without the Help of Assistants)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horseman confronting a bull in a ring. The scene depicts a person on horseback grappling with a charging bull within an enclosed area resembling an arena or bullring. The horse appears startled as it attempts to dodge or turn away from the bull. The composition includes a background wall with a crowd of onlookers observing the action from the stands, adding depth and context to the setting. The lines and shading bring a sense of motion and tension to the image, capturing the dramatic interaction between the bull and the rider.

artworks.title: El diestrisimo estudiante de Falces, embozadoburla al toro con sus quiebros (The Very Skillful Student of Falces, Wrapped in His Cape, Tricks the Bull with the Play of His Body)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bull in a bullring. The bull appears to be in motion, clashing with a cloaked figure. Shading is used to define forms and add depth. The upper part of the drawing shows an audience in an indistinct manner. The scene captures a moment of intense energy.

artworks.title: El famoso Martincho poniendo banderillas al quiebro (The Famous Martincho Places the Banderillas Playing the Bull with the Movement of His Body)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bull being restrained by a figure in an arena. The scene depicts a bullfight where a figure is wrestling and controlling a bull by its horns. The setting shows shadows on the ground with a minimal background, possibly suggesting an audience or panel. The drawing conveys movement and strength through lines and shading techniques.

artworks.title: El mismo vuelca un toro en la plaza de Madrid (The Same Man Throws a Bull in the Ring at Madrid)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bullfighting scene. It features a bull in the foreground facing off against a figure. In the background, two other figures are seen, one with an outstretched arm holding a hat. The contrast between the bull and the figures creates a sense of tension and movement. The image likely portrays themes of bravery and confrontation. The background is a dark expanse that emphasizes the central action. This is in the style of Francisco Goya.

artworks.title: Palenque de los moros hecho con burros para defenderse del toro embolado (The Moors Use Donkeys as a Barrier to Defend Themselves against the Bull Whose Horns have been Tipped with Balls)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bullfighting scene. The composition features a bull engaged with several figures. The bull stands at the center, with one hoof raised. One figure approaches cautiously from the right, and two figures stand positioned from the left. The background is stark and dark, emphasizing the activity within the arena. Shadows and line work emphasize the energy and tension of the moment. This is in the style of Francisco Goya, known for his series of etchings depicting bullfighting.

artworks.title: Temeridad de martincho en la plaza de Zaragoza (The Daring of Martincho in the Ring a t Saragossa)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bull confronting a seated figure holding a shield or hat in its path, watched by audience members in the background. The scene depicts a moment in a bullfighting arena where the attention is focused on the interaction between the bull and the figure holding the object in hand. The bull appears ready to move forward, adding tension and dynamism to the scene. On the left side of the painting, the stands are visible with several faces looking toward the action taking place. The painting uses a limited color palette of earthy tones and is rendered in a detailed and dramatic style.

artworks.title: Otra locura suya en la misma plaza (Another Madness of His in the Same Ring)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bull engaged in a bullfighting scene. The scene depicts a bull charging at a structure. There is movement in the bull's posture, as if it is aggressively lunging toward the target. To the right, an individual stands on the structure with raised arms. The background shows figures observing the event from the sidelines. The scene is conveyed in a monochromatic palette with detailed cross-hatching and line work in an etching style.

artworks.title: Valor varonil de la celebre Pajuelera en la de Zaragoza (Manly Courage of the Celebrated Pajuelera in the Ring at Saragossa)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: The image shows a bullfight scene with a horse and a bull in a confrontation within a bullring. The central focus is on the horse and rider with the rider holding a lance towards the charging bull. The background includes a textured wall and barrier, typical of a bullring. The scene depicts a tense moment with detailed attention to the anatomy and musculature of the animals, indicating motion and energy.

artworks.title: El mismo Ceballos montado sobre otro toro quiebra rejones en la plaza de Madrid (The Same Ceballos Mounted on Another Bull Breaks Short Spears in the Ring at Madrid)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bull and a horse in a bullfighting scene. The bull is engaged in combat with a horse, ridden by an unseen figure. The bull is charging with its head down and horns pointed forward, while the horse is rearing up on its hind legs in response. The background is simple and consists of a textured, monochromatic space. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of works by artists known for capturing moments in bullfighting, such as Francisco Goya. The use of line work enhances the action and movement in the scene.

artworks.title: Echan perros al toro (They Loose Dogs on the Bull)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bull surrounded by dogs, with a horse and rider in the background. The bull is engaged with the dogs, which are shown in various positions indicating motion and struggle. A horse with a rider is moving away from the scene. The setting appears to be an arena, with minimal background details except for a simple horizontal band. The drawing effectively uses line and shading to convey texture and movement.

artworks.title: Caida de un picador de su caballo debajo del toro (A Picador is Unhorsed and Falls under the Bull)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bullfighting scene. The drawing shows two bulls standing over a fallen matador with spectators in the background. The onlookers are leaning over the barrier, watching the event with animated expressions. The art style uses strong contrast and detailed linework to show texture and shading. The drawing is in the style of Francisco Goya, reflecting the expressive depiction of Spanish bullfighting scenes in his work.

artworks.title: El celebre Fernando del Toro, barilarguero, obligando a la fiera con su garrocha (The celebrated Picador, Fernando del Toro, Draws the Fierce Beast on with His Pique)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bullfight scene. The image features a bull in the foreground, facing figures on horseback. The arena is filled with tension, shown through the movement and postures of the horses and figures. In the background, there are blurred figures or a crowd. The drawing depicts the dynamic movement and detail of the setting, showcasing the traditional atmosphere of the bullfighting event.
